snippet.title: (OUT NOW) EVIL LEAFY MAZE GAME: DELUXE (TRAILER)
snippet.description:
CHECK THE GAME OUT: https://m23yh.itch.io/evil-leafy-maze-game-deluxe

​EVIL LEAFY MAZE GAME: DELUXE

​Evil Leafy Maze Game: Deluxe is a fan-made recreation of The Evil Leafy Maze Game, ​with new content that adds much more features and replayability!

You can play the original Evil Leafy Maze Game at bfdi.tv/maze!

I've been working on this game now for a month, its been just a lil project ive been working on the side... im pretty proud of it cuz its my first actual game that isnt something stupid lol.

very evil... very maze game...

#bfdi #battlefordreamisland #bfdia #tpot #bfb #evilleafymazegame #objectshow #objectshowcommunity
